scope: Read-only API feasibility review and offline GraphQL validation; no cloud API request or authentication change.

officialReadShape.authentication: Existing Content read-only token in X-API-KEY header or server-only SDK config; never URL, browser session extraction or committed value.
officialReadShape.sdk: createClient from tinacms/dist/client; generated queries or client.request({query,variables}, {fetchOptions}).
officialReadShape.collectionQuery: toolPage(relativePath: "jpg-compressor.json") { heading introduction sections { heading body } faqMode faq { q a } seoTitle seoDescription relatedTools }
officialReadShape.internalValuesField: Present in generated schema, but official single-document docs identify _values as edit-mode internal data not intended for external use; no _values external audit contract claimed.

limitations: Only actual mounted visible controls count. Collapsed/hidden/unmounted fields remain NOT_OBSERVED.
Exact document and visibly confirmed main branch required; contradictory captures remain failures.
No browser-local editor state, hidden serialized object or request/session inspection is used.
Single-line named AX controls can be parsed; unsupported/multiline or unnamed controls require explicit actual visible-control observations.
nativeFallback.branchScope: Project configuration main verified; no editor branch-switch label observed. Field-value coverage is reported separately from direct editor-branch proof.

navigationPlan.sourceScope: Expected source traversal plan only; root must inspect current DOM before any navigation.

visibleTechnicalRepresentations: Raw empty arrays require an actually mounted, confirmed loaded list with observed visible row count zero. Unloaded/hidden is not empty.
Template identifiers compare declared template labels only when actual visible block type was observed; no hidden _template input is read.

nativeProjectConfiguration.mainBranchIndex: Listed; indexed 3 hours ago as displayed
nativeProjectConfiguration.scope: Root native read-only project/branch inspection; index presence/timestamp is not 29-record raw field parity or final source-commit identity.
